trace.question: Which user added a bounty amount of 50 to the post title mentioning variance?
trace.evidence: bounty amount of 50 refers to BountyAmount = 50; user refers to DisplayName; title mentioning variance refers to Title include 'variance'

attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE v.BountyAmount = 50
  AND p.Title LIKE '%variance%'

trace.final_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE v.BountyAmount = 50
  AND p.Title LIKE '%variance%'
trace.answer: Two users match: chl and shabbychef. The result doesn't indicate which one added the bounty of 50, so I can't name a single user from it.
